title: Juicy Fried Polish Potatoes Pancakes
description: A crispy and flavorful Polish dish featuring hojicha and deep-fried potatoes, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning.
instructions: Peel the potatoes and grate them using a box grater.
In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes, flour, hojicha powder, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Mix the ingredients together until just combined.
Heat the canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the potato mixture into the oil and flatten slightly.
Fry the pancakes for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the pancakes from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Melt the butter in the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Return the pancakes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Serve the pancakes hot, garnished with chopped fresh chives if desired.
